name: unknown_schema_config_settings_version
reason: runtime.migration.settingsVersion 2 (build reads 1): off the hot path the whole block resets to defaults with provenance "reset: newer settingsVersion"; ON the hot path config.LoadForCapture has no such reset and refuses, so all six hooks exit 0 with an empty output, session-start spawns no daemon, and logs/hook-quiet names the degraded mode; .qompack/config.json is byte-identical afterwards
